import ast, sys, runpy, types, json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/kali/OmnisAI/api/tests/test_contract_method_pg.py')
tree=ast.parse(p.read_text()); ns={}
for n in tree.body:
 if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in {'BOOTSTRAP','STOCK_NATIVE_FINISH','STARTUP_NATIVE_PRIMARY'} for t in n.targets):
  exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[n],type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),ns)
 if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='batch2_native_observer':
  exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[n],type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),ns)
core=ast.parse(ns['batch2_native_observer'](startup=False))
funcs=[n for n in core.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in {'native_finish','monitor_call','monitor_return','monitor_unwind'}]
results=[]; original=runpy._get_module_details
for variant in ['RETURN','SYSTEMEXIT0','PRIMARY_WITH_EMIT_FAILURE']:
 rows=[]; closed=[]; error=SystemExit(0) if variant=='SYSTEMEXIT0' else ValueError('PRIVATE_SENTINEL') if variant.startswith('PRIMARY') else None
 def emit(*args,**kw):
  if variant.startswith('PRIMARY') and args==('observer','EXIT'): raise OSError('synthetic cleanup failure')
  rows.append(list(args))
 g={'sys':sys,'stock_runpy_code':runpy._run_module_as_main.__code__,'phase_transition':lambda *a: rows.append(list(a)), 'emit':emit,'startup':False,'evidence_fd':123,'os':types.SimpleNamespace(close=lambda fd:closed.append(fd)),'phase_key':lambda code:None,'monitored':lambda code:False}
 exec(compile(ast.Module(body=funcs,type_ignores=[]),'<actual-generated-callbacks>','exec'),g)
 spec=__import__('importlib.machinery',fromlist=['ModuleSpec']).ModuleSpec('tui_gateway.entry',None,origin='<inert-source-control>')
 code=compile('raise _qa_error' if error else 'pass','<inert-source-control>','exec')
 runpy._get_module_details=lambda *a:('tui_gateway.entry',spec,code)
 sys.modules['__main__'].__dict__['_qa_error']=error
 tool=4; caught=None
 try:
  sys.monitoring.use_tool_id(tool,'normative-runpy-control')
  for event,name in [(sys.monitoring.events.PY_START,'monitor_call'),(sys.monitoring.events.PY_RETURN,'monitor_return'),(sys.monitoring.events.PY_UNWIND,'monitor_unwind')]:sys.monitoring.register_callback(tool,event,g[name])
  sys.monitoring.set_events(tool,sys.monitoring.events.PY_START|sys.monitoring.events.PY_RETURN|sys.monitoring.events.PY_UNWIND)
  try:runpy._run_module_as_main('tui_gateway.entry',alter_argv=False)
  except BaseException as e:caught=e
 finally:
  sys.monitoring.set_events(tool,0);sys.monitoring.free_tool_id(tool);runpy._get_module_details=original
 assert caught is error and closed==[123] and rows[0]==['BOOTSTRAP_RUNPY_ENTRY_BEGIN','ENTER'], (variant,rows,closed)
 if variant=='RETURN':assert ['BOOTSTRAP_RUNPY_ENTRY_BEGIN','END'] in rows
 if variant=='SYSTEMEXIT0':assert ['bootstrap-exit','NORMAL_SYSTEM_EXIT'] in rows
 results.append({'control':variant,'pass':True,'primary_preserved':caught is error,'closed_count':len(closed)})
print(json.dumps({'scope':'SOURCE real runpy code; module resolution inert-substituted; generated callbacks unchanged; no native imports','controls':results}))
